sentences.en: We have to defend our country from the foreign aggression.
sentences.zh: 我们必须保卫我们的国家免受外来侵略。

sentences.en: Yanni's dog has some aggression issues he is working on.
sentences.zh: 雅尼的狗有一些攻击性问题，他正在努力解决这些问题。

sentences.en: People who are prone to aggression can be dangerous.
sentences.zh: 容易冲动的人可能会很危险。

senses.zh: 侵略, 侵犯,挑衅 - 侵略行为，侵犯行为
